name: Is It Love? Blue Swan Hospital
source:
In this episode, you're a grown teen who just left medical school and enters as a first-year doctor in the emergency room of one of the most prestigious hospital on the West Coast, the Blue Swan. You know this is a-once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and you can't screw it up. Being part of the Swans is any young doctor dream come true. As an aspiring doctor, you are prepared to deal with life-or-death consequences on a daily basis, Or are you? It's going to be tough, your nerves will be wrecked and your supervisor will not make life easy for you, But you'll meet friendly colleagues, each one with a different story and calling, with whom to build strong romance, And you may even find love, It's up to you to make your own choices and create your own stories…

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.isitlove.blueswan]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在本集中，你是一名刚刚离开医学院的成年青少年，作为一年级医生进入西海岸最负盛名的医院之一蓝天鹅医院的急诊室。你知道这是千载难逢的机会，你不能搞砸了。成为天鹅队的一员是任何年轻医生的梦想成真。作为一名有抱负的医生，你准备好每天应对生死攸关的后果，或者你准备好了吗？这会很艰难，你的神经会崩溃，你的主管不会让你的生活变得轻松，但你会遇到友好的同事，每个人都有不同的故事和使命，与他们建立牢固的浪漫，你甚至可能找到爱情，这取决于你做出自己的选择，创造你自己的故事……

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.isitlove.blueswan]Google Play[/url]]
